# FotMob fixtures — Phase 4

**Provenance: real recorded FotMob matchDetails payload, trimmed from the capture without
changing retained keys, nesting, or value types.** Recorded 2026-07-31 from a live browser session
for the finished Premier League match Arsenal 1–0 Newcastle United (match `4813706`, played
2026-04-25).

`matchdetails-ft.json` keeps four starters per team, their real `performance.rating` values, the
object-shaped `content.matchFacts.playerOfTheMatch`, five real shotmap entries, five momentum
points, and selected real Top stats entries.
